survey.what_is_it: app/extension — Ableton Live 12 extension (.ablx) that analyzes & transposes MIDI clips; consumes the Tonality (mts) engine via a local dependency-free Python HTTP bridge

architecture_rung.earned_by: ~411 LOC thin client + bridge, single developer, no parallelizable verifiable work; subagents' ~7-15x token cost is unjustified. Human-selected, not defaulted.

survey.domain_core_llm_must_not_own: The music-theory core is NOT in this repo — it lives in Tonality (mts). Per INTEGRATIONS rule 3 this repo must never reimplement it. Local deterministic logic is limited to MIDI transpose (pure arithmetic + 0-127 clamp, extension/src/transform.ts) and JSON<->Sequence marshalling in bridge/server.py. Nothing AI-driven in the runtime path.

oracle_shape.goldens: invariants + smoke — no pinned goldens yet (transpose + bridge-marshal unit suites tracked as debt, ROADMAP Q-002)
oracle_shape.ci: single-version smoke: tsc --noEmit + py_compile (fast); + esbuild build + live bridge /health+/analyze contract, skipped-with-notice when the engine is absent (full)

consumes: Tonality (mts) — via bridge import (from mts.mcp.tools import midi_file_analysis); the /transform seam is a documented gap, brief filed
consumed_by: the owner, inside Ableton Live 12 Beta

lifespan_autonomy.autonomy_tier: interactive — agents propose, human ratifies at gates; no unattended runs
